Subject: Quick ask — would Vertica do a 2-3min customer video?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for your team's help on the pilot — the results were great. Our marketing lead asked whether we could do a short 2-3 minute customer video (on-camera interview + b-roll of product in use) to highlight the integration and cost savings. Would Redwood be interested?

A few constraints on our side: we need an approved release form, a short script/talking points to sign off, and an on-site crew window the week of Oct 12–16 (we're based in Boston). We can also do a remote interview if that’s easier.

If you're open, can you propose a lightweight run-of-show and who from Redwood would be on the call? I can loop in our comms/ops and legal if helpful.

Thanks — Elena

Marissa/Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. The draft looks good overall. Two small requests from our comms team:
1) Can we soften the cost-savings quote — change the line to “significant reduction in time-to-resolution” rather than a hard percent (legal prefers conservative language).
2) We need the release to include a clause referencing PHI handling — we cannot have Redwood retain any patient-level data; only aggregated/anonymized screenshots are permitted. I’ve CC'd Simon from Ops and our legal inbox.

We'd prefer on-site capture in Boston, but the earliest full crew availability on our side is Oct 14 or Oct 15. If Redwood can do those dates, we’ll proceed. Also please send the DocuSign for the release so our legal team can pre-review.

Thanks — Elena
